name: pr-review-board
description: React to a pull request with an emoji and a background Claude reviews it. A local poller watches GitHub for reactions you added, then spawns one review agent per changeset in its own herdr workspace. The plain-English report opens in a pane beside the agent, live in nvim as it is written and linked to the code it calls out. It ends by proposing a numbered list of comments and posts only the ones you pick. Never approves, never pushes.
